content_sections.heading: THSTI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the THSTI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download THSTI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria

rows.event: Walk-in Interview for Technician and Field Worker

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) for various project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 33 vacancies available for Research Nurse, Technician, and Field Worker positions in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available posts include Research Nurse (18 vacancies), Technician (12 vacancies), and Field Worker (3 vacancies) under the Placenta Health Project.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a written test, skill test, or interview as conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to submit any online or offline application forms in advance.

faq.question: Q6. What are the walk-in interview dates?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Research Nurse is scheduled for 24-10-2026, while the interview for Technician and Field Worker will take place on 26-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at 9:00 AM on the scheduled date at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad - 121001.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 38,500/- depending on the specific post they are recruited for.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their latest CV or resume, one set of photocopies of all educational and experience documents along with originals, and a valid ID card.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of THSTI?
faq.answer: The official website of the Translational Health Science and Technology Institute to check further updates is https://thsti.res.in.
